entries.title: Frozenheim

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Frozenheim is documented on Steam as a Paranoid Interactive Viking settlement/RTS game released on June 16, 2022, with Windows system requirements and Steam as the sourced platform route. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so the Windows PC build is both the complete route and the best capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release and use the latest patch before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with the full Steam route and best capture/settings control.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster, definitive edition, or platform-exclusive content exists.
